description: Return the file tree of a Godot project. Use to discover project structure when paths are unknown. subfolder lists one folder as the root (maxDepth counts from it). extensions filters files (e.g. ["gd","tscn"]) and drops directories with no match; maxDepth -1 is unlimited. Skips dot-prefixed entries. Returns: the root node { name, type, path, children[] }; a child is a file, a directory, or a link (not followed). A directory not opened or unreadable has children null; warnings leads then.

extensions.description: Filter to only these file extensions (e.g. ["gd", "tscn"]); directories with no match are left out. Omit to include all.

maxDepth.description: Maximum recursion depth, counted from the listed root. -1 means unlimited (default: -1)

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

subfolder.description: Folder inside the project to list instead of the whole project (e.g. "ui/themes" or "res://ui"). Must exist and be a directory. Omit for the project root.

name: get_project_files

children.description: Directories only. Each child has this same shape. Null when the directory was not opened (maxDepth) or could not be read.

extension.description: Files only, lower case, no dot.

warnings.description: Root node only: depth cuts, unreadable paths and links that were not followed.
